text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall despite several down periods, so I should evaluate progress over a longer horizon rather than react to monthly swings.","After selling Stock E following a large gain, I should remember that past gains and my average cost do not predict future prices; trades should follow a plan instead.","I bought all five stocks after a run of declines. Since those declines do not predict a rebound, I should size positions deliberately, keep diversification in mind, and avoid trading just because I check prices often."]}
